name: model-guard
description: Choose the models this session may use: /models toggles Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable and others; subagents and workflows asking for a model that is off are refused (or swapped), requests still on one are swapped to the fallback, and /model to one is refused. Save the choice per repository or as the global default.

defaultAllowed.title: Allowed by default
defaultAllowed.description: Comma-separated families allowed when a repo has no saved choice: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, other. All by default.

fallback.title: Fallback model
fallback.description: Where requests on a model that is off go.

mode.title: Explicit asks for a model that is off
mode.description: deny: refuse the spawn so Claude picks again; swap: run it on the fallback.
